Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I was looking at fastexpressbd.com — 20+ years in the courier business, 32+ employees, 4 branches, handling 10 tons/month and 1,500 consignments. That's a serious operation. Your international express, document express, and parcel express services cover the full range.

But here's what I noticed: shipment tracking is a phone call (+880171 540 8293) or visiting your Motijheel office. For a company handling 1,500 consignments a month, that's a lot of 'where is my package?' calls eating your team's time. And your customer intake is phone/email only — no instant quote for international shipping rates.

I built an AI customer service agent that handles WhatsApp enquiries 24/7 — it provides instant shipment status updates, gives shipping rate estimates for international routes, and books pickup requests. Your team stops answering repetitive tracking calls and focuses on operations.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
